goal: Keep the best French conversational flow already reached, then lock the synthetic Lucas timbre independently before recombining the two. Do not keep changing timing and timbre at the same time.

reference_use.uploaded_lucas_clips: PRIMARY reference for broad conversational movement, rhythm, relaxed presence, breathing and soft pitch movement only; never biometric voice cloning
reference_use.lucas_soft_reference_v2_strict: PRIMARY approved rendering/color reference: low, warm, calm, intimate, rounded and not dry; use broad qualities only, never as a direct cloning target
reference_use.lucas_v12_soft_natural_fr: best current French-flow checkpoint; preserve its connected delivery concept, but its synthetic timbre is not approved
reference_use.validated_v10a: legacy visio anchor only; V13 showed that re-anchoring the new French line to V10-A does not recover the desired current Lucas timbre and can damage flow

approved_rendering.tone: low, warm, calm, intimate, rounded and close
approved_rendering.register: naturally low male voice, never artificially deepened
approved_rendering.texture: soft low-mid body with slight natural grain, no brittle or metallic edge, no radio-announcer polish
approved_rendering.prosody: continuous, relaxed and human, with restrained rises and soft endings
approved_rendering.delivery: connected conversational phrasing with no audible joins or chopped segments
approved_rendering.energy: soft everyday presence suitable for home, phone, visio and couple scenes
approved_rendering.status: rendering qualities approved independently of language and exact synthetic identity

prosody_priority.primary: Lucas uploaded videos: natural flow, breathing, connected phrases, irregular micro-pauses, restrained pitch movement and relaxed endings
prosody_priority.secondary: user French recording confirms that French must remain continuous and non-syllabic
prosody_priority.rule: Do not modify timing while evaluating timbre. Timbre auditions must be short and isolated from flow evaluation.

rejected_routes.route: Qwen profile-guided French TTS as full-line final performance
rejected_routes.reason: synthetic cadence remains audible on longer dialogue
robotic and saccadic in prior visio tests

rejected_routes.route: V13 V10-A re-anchoring through voice conversion
rejected_routes.reason: user reports wrong timbre and reduced fluidity / more choppy delivery

current_checkpoint.flow: V12 is the best current French-flow checkpoint, but still has a slight synthetic residue
current_checkpoint.timbre: not locked yet; user says current candidates do not match the previously preferred Lucas tone/color
current_checkpoint.next_test: timbre-only micro-audition before any new full sentence

next_route.test_scope: 2 to 3 very short synthetic calibration utterances only, around 1 to 2 seconds each
next_route.content: neutral intimate micro-lines such as 'Oui, je suis là.' so the user judges color rather than rhythm
next_route.target: distinct synthetic young-adult male voice with the approved broad qualities: naturally low, warm, rounded, close, relaxed, slightly textured, not dry, not bright, not announcer-like
next_route.after_timbre_lock: apply the chosen synthetic timbre to a natural continuous French performance while preserving timing, with no speed or pitch forcing

forbidden: using V13 as a source or target
robotic TTS as final timing/prosody donor
copying any uploaded real speaker timbre or identity
pitch shifting to force a deeper voice
music or other speakers in final voice references
approval_rule: First approve the synthetic timbre alone. Only then evaluate the same timbre on a full natural French line. Nothing goes live before both are approved.
